Chapter Details: Status of national population, civil, address, land, business, electoral, tax and social protection registers. 44 variables in 8 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: Digital biometric electoral register managed by CNTDE (computerized, centralized, biométrisation); Electoral Code 2023 describes full management system with mirror site, annual revisions; deployed since 2015 elections.
revision_notes: Original score of 5 (Fully deployed nationwide) confirmed. First cited source (justice.gouv.km) verified and supports the score: Electoral Code 2023 (Loi n°22-017/AU, Article 7) describes a computerised, centralised fichier électoral held by the Centre National de Traitement des Données Electorales (CNTDE) under CENI supervision, with biometric national ID required for enrolment. The second cited source (idea.int data-tools export URL) could not be rendered as a webpage (returns a non-HTML export rather than an article) so was not directly verifiable, but this is consistent with it being a machine-readable IDEA data export rather than a dead or unrelated link. Supplementary searches found a UNDP Comoros project page on modernising the fichier électoral (noting c.70% of eligible voters enrolled as of the 2015 elections) and an official Cour Suprême electoral decision (24 January 2024) confirming 338,940 registered voters on the roll used for the January 2024 presidential election. Together these corroborate a fully operational, nationwide, computerised electoral register still in active use as of 2024. No evidence found that would raise or lower the code; confirmed at 5 with high confidence.
revised_comments: Comoros maintains a computerised and centralised electoral register (fichier électoral), held by the Centre National de Traitement des Données Electorales (CNTDE) under the Commission Electorale Nationale Indépendante (CENI), as established by the Electoral Code 2023 (Loi n°22-017/AU du 27 décembre 2022). The register uses biometric national identity documents for enrolment verification and has been in operation since the 2015 legislative elections. It was most recently used for the January 2024 presidential election, with 338,940 electors recorded on the digitised national roll covering all three islands and diplomatic/consular representations for Comorians abroad.
